usedFor: monday.com holds your boards, and Elasticsearch receives a document when “Item Column Value Changes” runs “Create Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Create Document” in Elasticsearch
bestTemplate.why: Every column change is stored as its own document, so you can search the history of an item.

watchOut: “Create Document” takes the index name from inside the document, so include it in every payload.
